description: Auto Send Food To Camp compatibility test. P1 — minimal MCM-dependent Osiris, Events, and Vars smoke test.
assertions: assert((function() for _,u in ipairs(Ext.Mod.GetLoadOrder()) do local m=Ext.Mod.GetMod(u); local n=string.gsub(string.lower((m and m.Info and m.Info.Name) or ''), '[%s_%-]', ''); if string.find(n, 'sendfood', 1, true) then return true end end return false end)(), 'Auto Send Food present in load order')
assert((function() local id=Ext.Events.Tick:Subscribe(function() end); local ok=type(id) == 'number'; Ext.Events.Tick:Unsubscribe(id); return ok end)(), 'Tick event subscribe roundtrip executes')
notes: Requires MCM; the runner injects it automatically. Simple MCM smoke test with a minimal API surface.
